items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I played with John Robichaux's band... I played guitar with him at the Lyric Theater.

ctx.x: Uh, Sunday night over at the Greenough, you mentioned that you'd played with Robichaux

before. I played with John Robichaux's band, the old man Robichaux, yeah. I played guitar with him at the Lyric Theater. But I, I don't think I stayed with him over a year. Right after I left, he got Kutche Martin on the guitar. Then after he, Kutche Martin stayed with him about a year or so. Then he got Bud Scott. And they went, they, uh, they was playing jobs, spot jobs, all out in the pool and building all out throughout the country. And then Bud Scott stayed with him until the band went down.

Uh, I know it's difficult to remember exact dates all the time. I don't like to bother you with all those dates. But do you know about when that would be? Was it before the First World War or after? Oh, yeah. Real early?
